prompt_text:
Today is 2026-06-04.

You are forecasting outcomes of a Major League Baseball regular-season game.

Game details:
  Date:        2026-06-13
  Matchup:     San Diego Padres at Baltimore Orioles
  Venue:       Oriole Park at Camden Yards
  First pitch: 2026-06-13T20:05:00Z (game time)

Predict the following five quantities for this game. For each, provide a point estimate and a 90% confidence interval. A 90% confidence interval means you are providing a low value and a high value such that you believe there is a 90% chance the true value will fall between them. If we asked you to make this kind of estimate 100 times, the true value should fall inside your interval on about 90 of those occasions. Choose your bounds accordingly.

Quantities:
  1. total_runs        — Total runs scored in the game (both teams combined)
  2. total_strikeouts  — Total batter strikeouts in the game (both teams combined)
  3. total_home_runs   — Total home runs hit in the game (both teams combined)
  4. duration_min      — Game duration in minutes (from first pitch to final out, including replays and pitching changes; excludes pre/post-game)
  5. attendance        — Paid attendance at the game (announced figure)

Respond ONLY with valid JSON and no markdown fences:
{
  "total_runs":       {"point_estimate": <number>, "90_ci": [<low>, <high>]},
  "total_strikeouts": {"point_estimate": <number>, "90_ci": [<low>, <high>]},
  "total_home_runs":  {"point_estimate": <number>, "90_ci": [<low>, <high>]},
  "duration_min":     {"point_estimate": <number>, "90_ci": [<low>, <high>]},
  "attendance":       {"point_estimate": <number>, "90_ci": [<low>, <high>]}
}
